# 207 Studio

> Apps and developer kits from 207 Studio (207studio.dev), an independent software studio in South Korea. Developer kits and classroom tools are one-time purchases with full source.

## Products

- [PPTX Player SDK – Play PowerPoint in the Browser](https://207studio.dev/products/pptx-player-sdk/): Play PowerPoint in the browser with every animation: a client-side PPTX to HTML/SVG engine that works offline. Prices: Developer $14 / Commercial $129.
- [PairyCore SDK: Mac-to-iPad Screen Streaming](https://207studio.dev/products/pairy-core-sdk/): Put a live Mac screen on an iPad and send touch, keyboard, clipboard and dictation back: the streaming engine from a working Mac + iPad remote app, as a Swift package. Prices: Commercial $129.
- [Scan-to-Grade: Scanned Exams to Excel (Python)](https://207studio.dev/products/scan-to-grade-bundle/): QR Cropper and OMR Auto-Grader together: a scanned batch in, an Excel gradebook out. Prices: Personal $79 / Commercial $299.
- [OMR Auto-Grader – Bubbles, O/X, Circled Answers](https://207studio.dev/products/omr-auto-grader/): Reads bubbles, circled words, O/X boxes and ordering marks on scanned sheets, and fills in only the grades it is sure of. Prices: Personal $59 / Commercial $249.
- [QR Answer-Sheet Cropper – Crop Every Answer Box](https://207studio.dev/products/qr-cropper/): Print a QR on each sheet, scan a mixed batch, and get every answer cell back as a clean, aligned image. Prices: Personal $39 / Commercial $149.
- [Context-Gated Voice Commands – Offline](https://207studio.dev/products/voice-command-engine/): A Rust library and CLI that infers the current situation from audio features and lets through only the voice commands that fit it. Prices: Personal/Research $29 / Commercial $99.
- [ShapeFit – Hold-to-Shape for Swift & Rust](https://207studio.dev/products/shapefit/): Turn a hand-drawn stroke into a clean line, circle, rectangle or polygon when the user pauses, for your own drawing app. Prices: Personal $9 / Commercial $29.
- [Exam + OMR Sheet Builder – Paper, Sheet & Key](https://207studio.dev/products/exam-sheet-builder/): Write an exam once and print a matching exam paper, OMR answer sheet, answer key, explanation sheet and cover page. Prices: Personal $12 / Commercial $35.
- [Offline Classroom Tools – Seating, PACER Timer](https://207studio.dev/products/classroom-html-tools/): Four single-file classroom tools: a seating chart with attendance, a morning board, a fitness test recorder and Wi-Fi QR cards. Prices: Teacher $9 / School $19.
- [Send Approval Gate MCP: Plan, Approve, Send, Verify](https://207studio.dev/products/send-approval-gate-mcp/): An MCP server that makes an AI agent plan, present an exact hash-bound approval, send once and verify, and records every step. Prices: Developer $29 / Commercial $99.

## Apps

- [Pairy: Connecting Devices](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6815584225): Remote desktop for your tablet. Shows your computer's screen on your tablet and lets you control it with touch, trackpad and keyboard. Free on the App Store with no subscription (an optional in-app tip unlocks nothing); the Mac companion is a free notarized download. How it works and the Mac companion: https://207studio.dev/pairy/
- [Pairy for Mac 1.4.2 (build 142)](https://github.com/207studio/207studio.github.io/releases/download/pairy-mac-1.4.2-142/Pairy-mac-1.4.2-142-notarized.zip): direct download. Apple Silicon only, macOS 15 or later. Notarized with Developer ID. Double-click the zip to unzip it, then move PairyMac.app into Applications.

## In development

- [Chalkieboard](https://chalkieboard.207studio.dev/) (초키보드): an iPad lesson board app for elementary school teachers. Board writing with subject tools, PPTX and HWP lesson files opened in the app, and AirPlay to the classroom display. No personal data is collected during class. In beta on TestFlight.
- CheckyBoard: a Windows app for checking paper exams one question at a time. The teacher marks each answer, and the app makes answer sheets, splits scans into per-question boxes, and produces scores, item analysis and report cards.
- [StoneWars](https://207studio.dev/stonewars/): five in a row on a 15×15 board in 3D for iPhone, iPad and Mac, with eight stone classes and seven worlds. Preparing for App Store release.
- Ttoryeot (또렷): an HWP/HWPX document engine written in Rust. Opens Korean 한글 documents and renders them to PDF or images without 한글 installed. View only. One engine for Mac, iOS, Windows and the web. Not released yet.

## Licensing

- Commercial licenses cover companies with annual revenue up to $1M. Above that, email support@207studio.dev for an Enterprise license. All purchases are one-time; no subscriptions.

## When to use 207 Studio kits

- You need to play or preview .pptx files in a web page with click-by-click animations, without a server or Office: PPTX Player SDK.
- You grade paper exams and want scanned sheets turned into scores: QR Answer-Sheet Cropper, OMR Auto-Grader, or Scan-to-Grade (Python).
- You make printed exams with matching OMR sheets and keys: Exam + OMR Sheet Builder.
- You need offline voice commands that only fire in the right situation: Context-Gated Voice Commands (Rust).
- You build a Mac-to-iPad remote screen or drawing app: PairyCore SDK, ShapeFit.
- You want an AI agent to plan, get an exact approval, send once and verify: Send Approval Gate MCP.

## How to buy (for agents)

- Polar is the main checkout. Every product page lists tiers with a direct Polar link; card payment, one-time, instant download, no account needed beforehand.
- Paddle is the alternative checkout (card or PayPal): https://207studio.dev/pay/
- Machine-readable prices and buy URLs: schema.org Product/Offer JSON-LD on each product page, and https://207studio.dev/llms-full.txt
- Questions or Enterprise quotes: support@207studio.dev

## Writing

- [How to play a PPTX in the browser (without PowerPoint)](https://207studio.dev/blog/play-pptx-in-browser/): Render a .pptx in the browser without a server or Office. What breaks the animations, three ways to do it, and how to test any viewer in five minutes.
